## What this changes

A short description of the change and why.

Closes #<!-- issue number, if any -->

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New detection rule / analyzer
- [ ] Feature / enhancement
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`python -m pytest tests/ -q`; `cd detonation && go test ./...` if Go changed)
- [ ] New/changed detection has a regression-corpus case where it makes sense (see `docs/regression-testing.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for any user-facing change
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or config changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private intel-pack content included
- [ ] Commits are signed off for the DCO (`git commit -s`) — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything specific you'd like feedback on, trade-offs you made, or follow-ups you're deferring.
